infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to compute prayer times, the Qibla direction, and to detect when you are home so the azan sound can play.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Background location lets the app switch between the azan sound (at home) and a normal notification (away from home).
